blurb: Guests can learn to sail, kayak, rent boats and fishing gear, and enjoy recreational boating and fishing. The center offers adult and junior sailing programs, summer camps, and a variety of rental boats including kayaks, paddleboards, powerboats, and sailboats. The marina provides deep water slips, a fishing pier, boat ramp, and amenities such as a bait and tackle store and free WiFi.
extraNote: Advanced registration required for courses · Challenge attempts allowed twice per course with partial refund if backing out
